Section heading.
markdownResponse sets text/markdown with charset deliberately; whether it survives depends on the server.
The Cloudflare adapter does not write a prerendered route Response headers into the _headers file.
wrangler dev returns the same content type whatever the route sets, so Cloudflare derives it from the extension.
vite preview serves text/markdown with no charset.
The charset ships correctly on Cloudflare only by coincidence; vite preview is no reliable stand-in.
The finding was measured under wrangler dev only, not on a live zone, and for no other extension.
Verify another extension the same way before relying on the coincidence.
